query: 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary status: Byron Donalds candidacy, opponents, Trump endorsement, polling, competitors dropping out. Who is running against Donalds and what are the polls showing as of mid-2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary of my findings on the 2026 Florida Republican gubernatorial primary as of mid-2026:

## Bottom Line
**Byron Donalds is the overwhelming, Trump-endorsed frontrunner** heading into the August 18, 2026 primary, leading by 40+ points in every poll and consolidating establishment support.

### Who's running against Donalds
- **Jay Collins** — Lt. Governor (DeSantis appointee), polling ~4–11%
- **James Fishback** — conservative investor, DeSantis-aligned, ~4–12%
- **Paul Renner** — former FL House Speaker, ~2–4%
- (~11–12 GOP candidates total qualified, but these four dominate)

### Trump endorsement
Trump endorsed Donalds extraordinarily early — **February 20, 2025** ("RUN, BYRON, RUN!"), widely seen as a snub of DeSantis.

### Polling trajectory (all show Donalds dominant)
- **Emerson (late Mar 2026):** Donalds 46%, Collins 4%, Fishback 4%, undecided 39%
- **Cygnal (Jul 12–13, 2026):** Donalds 43%, Fishback 12%, Collins 11%, Renner 2%, undecided 31%
- **Fabrizio, Lee (Jul 14–16, 2026):** Donalds 53%, Collins 10%, Fishback 9%, Renner 4%
- May Fabrizio and June AIF polls also had Donalds >50%

### Dropouts / consolidation
No major candidate formally withdrew by mid-July 2026. The key dynamic instead: **DeSantis's own appointees defected to Donalds** in July (AG Uthmeier, CFO Ingoglia, Ag Commissioner Simpson). **Casey DeSantis considered running in 2025 but never entered**. Notably, **Ron DeSantis himself has refused to endorse anyone**, fueling a "Republican family feud" — but his opposition hasn't dented Donalds's dominance.

One caveat worth flagging: a persistent large undecided bloc (24–39%) exists across polls, though Donalds's lead has been consistent and durable across every independent pollster.

key_facts: Florida GOP gubernatorial primary is August 18, 2026; general election November 3, 2026; Gov. Ron DeSantis is term-limited.
Byron Donalds (U.S. Rep., R-Naples) is the clear frontrunner; announced his campaign in late February 2026.
President Trump endorsed Donalds very early, on February 20, 2025 — over a year before the primary.
Main opponents running against Donalds: Lt. Gov. Jay Collins, investor James Fishback, and former House Speaker Paul Renner.
Casey DeSantis considered running in 2025 but did NOT enter the race; she appears only in hypothetical polls.
Ron DeSantis has refused to endorse any candidate, creating a 'Republican family feud'; he called Renner's run 'ill-advised.'
In July 2026 DeSantis allies (AG James Uthmeier, CFO Blaise Ingoglia, Ag Commissioner Wilton Simpson) defected to endorse Donalds.
Cygnal (Jul 12-13, 2026, 500 LV): Donalds 43%, Fishback 12%, Collins 11%, Renner 2%, undecided 31%.
Fabrizio, Lee & Associates (Jul 14-16, 2026, 400 LV): Donalds 53%, Collins 10%, Fishback 9%, Renner 4%.
Donalds leads by 40+ points in every poll and is at/above 50% in several (also >50% in May Fabrizio and June AIF polls).
No major GOP candidate had formally dropped out by mid-July 2026; consolidation flowed toward Donalds.
General election (Emerson late March 2026): Donalds 44% vs Democrat David Jolly 39%; race rated Solid/Likely Republican.
David Jolly (former GOP congressman turned Democrat) is the leading Democratic candidate (~21% in Dem primary).
